items.title: Shirley Lewis Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: And, um, Slow Drake, Mr. Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: All right, today is Tuesday, March 25th, 1969. Is that what's right? Yeah, that's right. And we're interviewing Shirley George's daughter at 3rd 3rd 27th, the Arnold Street. Just a second time. Okay, well Shirley, tell me about your, let's say, early memories or earliest memories around, I guess that was the time when you were around on St. Philip Street. Would that be right? Yeah.

Do you remember that time? That would be about right. That's when my now and Jeffries met Bill Russell. Yeah. He and a couple of other guys, I don't know their name offhand, came to the house and, um, he didn't believe in banks. He asked my mother to keep his money for him. A lot of them spent the night on the floor. And I understand that was when they made the recording of the Bundy Street Blues in the backyard. And then, um, Lawrence. Who? Lawrence. Yeah, and Uncle Lawrence to me. And, um, Slow Drake, Mr. Jim…
And, um, he and Ron Johnson used to kid me a lot.
